1.4 Python comparison command

uv run python compare_dng.py LEFT RIGHT [options]
Option Default Purpose
--output DIRECTORY dng-report Reports and comparison checkpoint
--workers N 2 Concurrent image pairs; must be positive
--batch-size N 32 Candidate pairs per metadata/checkpoint batch
--sample N Full candidate set Evenly spaced candidate pairs
--limit N Full candidate set First N candidate pairs
--fresh Reuse eligible cache Ignore saved comparison results

--sample and --limit are mutually exclusive. Their unit is a candidate pair, not necessarily a unique source image. If one basename has several copies on each side, sampling may select multiple candidates for the same left file and leave other left files untouched.

The program walks both roots recursively, includes extension-case variants of .dng, and ignores macOS ._ companion files. Basename matching itself is case-sensitive. Each left physical path is a coverage obligation. For a basename appearing several times, all candidates are scheduled, with the same-relative-path candidate first. Additional right files are ignored. Unreadable directories fail rather than silently disappearing from the scope.

This is a one-way containment check, not a two-way tree diff. To check the reverse direction, use a separate report directory and reverse the roots. A renamed DNG is missing under this matcher even if its bytes exist elsewhere. Use an explicit mapping or an independent identity investigation before treating that as actual original loss. Root membership and filename matches are candidate selection, never the final image proof.
